claim: Under the New Rail Financing Framework (NRFF) LTA owns the rail operating assets

claim: Under NRFF the operator collects fares and pays a licence charge

value: shortfall sharing exists; bands not published
quote: If ridership turns out much lower than projected and the financials of the operator suffer as a result, LTA shares some of the shortfall in fare revenue and profits.

claim: Under NRFF version two, higher profit-sharing through the licence charge effectively caps operator margins

quote: This also effectively caps the operator’s profit margins.
